routing_policy.bands: The player-facing level ranges belong to named hubs and pockets, not entire macro-regions.
routing_policy.duplication: Two alternatives in each onward slice; overlapping hubs and return pockets permit mixed routes.
routing_policy.accounting: Ten disjoint budget slices partition all 49 gains. User area bands such as 25–30, 30–40 and 45–50 overlap those slices and are never added as extra compulsory XP/time.
routing_policy.story_gates: Equivalent regional chapters should set one shared story outcome. OR/outcome-based quest gates and single-claim shared chapter rewards require engine work; do not encode both regional chains in the current all-required prerequisite list.
routing_policy.switching: Keep partial objectives and earned rewards, accept the next appropriate local job, and never require repeating the opening of the alternative zone.
routing_policy.state: Route plans and future regions only; current game has not gained these zones or branch-gate mechanics.

new_region_briefs.goal: Make the lowlands bracket playable through practical marsh life rather than a second river port.
new_region_briefs.story: A drainage cooperative holds flood-damaged duplicates of the relief accounts. Restoring a safe delivery circuit and comparing the surviving receipts can establish the same provenance that Rillbank finds in freight records.
local_stories: An eel fisher and a reed cutter dispute a blocked channel.
Recover flood-marked household records before a salvage dealer sells them as waste paper.
Hunt the marsh predator taking livestock from raised pens.
new_region_briefs.mechanics_boundary: These are briefs, not added quest records. Full content, traversal, enemies, services and alternate chapter gating remain to build.

new_region_briefs.goal: Offer a grounded upland route through the same levels as the volcanic frontier.
new_region_briefs.story: Common-land leases, quarry wage books and confiscated grazing rights expose another arm of the collection network. A local hearing can establish the same onward lead as Cinder’s industrial records.
local_stories: A horse breeder has hired an inspector who is afraid of horses.
Two villages disagree about who repairs the drove bridge before market day.
Track the raiders using abandoned quarry shelters.
new_region_briefs.mechanics_boundary: These are briefs, not added quest records. Do not imply mounts, hearings or defended repairs are already implemented.
